title: Fix Emoji Space In Ids
prompt: Fix emoji presentation in artifact IDs and URIs across all CLI list/tree commands. Remove U+FE0E text presentation selectors, fix duplicate emoji prefixes in file IDs/URIs, fix folder kind not appearing correctly, fix ticket tree intermediate nodes missing proper IDs/URIs. Extend test coverage for all list/tree markdown output.
